ls_provost.text: It's a splendid hall, if I say so myself. The windows are my favourites, with the Norse earls in their helmets. Up Helly Aa's feast is held in halls like this one, after the burning: the squads go from hall to hall all night, performing a short act at each, and drinking something warming at every stop.
By the end, it's a sight. Dozens of squads, a dozen halls. Everyone ends up in the wrong hall at least once. Nobody minds.
